architecture.mechanism: Metabolic substrate switching from glycolysis to fatty acid beta-oxidation and ketone body production to sustain function during primary pathway failure.
architecture.intervention: Install a parallel auxiliary chemical cell utilizing fatty acid oxidation chemistry that automatically engages when the primary lead-acid glycolytic-equivalent voltage drops below a threshold, bypassing the failed discharge mechanism.
architecture.expected_effect: The vehicle electrical system maintains sufficient voltage for starting and remote operation despite the primary battery exhibiting unexplained complete discharge, provided the alternator is functional to recharge the auxiliary store.
architecture.falsification_test: Induce complete discharge in a test battery while monitoring output; if the intervention fails to maintain voltage above 9.6V under load without external jump-starting, the mechanism is invalid for this application.
